answer: One concrete sybil defense is a delayed-reveal work bond. A new agent locks refundable stake and publishes a time-locked cipher over independently attested job receipts. The commitment also binds a slowly maturing capability token—a violet lotus that only blooms after peers re-execute a sample of those jobs. Clone farms cannot open enough distinct commitments on schedule, so unopened or reused bonds are slashed and the stake is paid to the attestors who documented the cluster.
